meta.note: Physics and biology are paired so the UI can give them equal space.

physics.explain: Laser light spin-polarises rubidium atoms; at zero field the vapour turns transparent, and a tiny field tips the spins and changes how much light gets through (a Lorentzian zero-field resonance).

signals: heart: magnetocardiography R-peak and Q wave
biology.comparison: recorded/eeg_brain_ds004902 (conventional EEG, not a quantum sensor)

nv.name: NV-diamond magnetometer (JGU, ZAQuant, Q.ANT builds; arXiv 2601.18843)

physics.quantum_effect: spin-1 NV centre; microwaves at about 2.87 GHz flip ms = 0 to ±1, seen as a fluorescence dip (optically detected magnetic resonance)
physics.explain: A field splits the two ODMR lines by 2γB (γ ≈ 28 MHz/mT); the builds carry a ~1 mT bias and read heart fields of tens of pT after averaging.

signals: heart: averaged MCG, R-peak and Q-wave SNR per build

qd_renin.name: Quantum-dot renin nanosensor (Long et al., Anal. Chem. 2012)

physics.explain: A quantum dot passes energy to Cy5 by FRET; renin cuts the peptide, Cy5 leaves, and the Cy5 count drops (single-molecule TIRF counting).

biology.nasa: renin is not in open Inspiration4 data (nasa_i4.not_found)

cqd_patch.name: Carbon quantum-dot microneedle patch (Tabatabaee et al., ACS Nano 2024)

physics.explain: Carbon-dot fluorescence is quenched and recovers selectively with bilirubin under blue light; carbon-dot emission is not a spin-based quantum measurement.
